lastResponse.text: I’m really glad you called. This is urgent safety. If you’re in immediate danger, call nine one one now. For a survivor advocate tonight, call The Safe House at 503… 397… 7710. I’ll repeat: 503… 397… 7710. If that line doesn’t answer, try 503… 397… 6161.
originalTexts: I’m really glad you called. This is urgent safety. If you’re in immediate danger, call 911 now. For a survivor advocate tonight, call The Safe House at **503… 397… 7710**. I’ll repeat: **503… 397… 7710**. If that line doesn’t answer, try **503… 397… 6161**.
